title: Arte nueva de escribir, inventada por el insigne maestro Pedro Díaz Morante, e ilustrada con muestras nuevas y varios discursos conducentes al verdadero magisterio de primeras letras
author: Francisco Javier de Santiago Palomares (1728–1796), after Pedro Díaz Morante (1565–1636); plates engraved by Francisco Asensio y Mejorada
place: Madrid: Imprenta de Antonio de Sancha
holder: Biblioteca de la Universidad de Sevilla (A 254/379), digitised by the library and published on the Internet Archive

rights.notes: Work of 1776, public domain everywhere. Chosen over the items the research named: the Castilla Benavides (1866, JCyL) PDF and the Getty Iturzaeta (1835) and Sevilla Servidori (1789) copies are text volumes without their plates. Palomares' bastarda is the model Servidori, Torío and Iturzaeta taught from.
